reviewScope: account + series plan and the complete first-episode single/video directing brief
evidenceHashes: no-external-evidence: review is bounded to the original task's user-supplied asset and constraint claims; no source artifact or public evidence was supplied for independent verification

reviewer.independenceStatement: Did not author or repair the candidate; reviewed only the permitted task, candidate, structural report, and governing skill references, without reading V0, observations, holdouts, other forward outputs, or old reviews.

gates.name: Coverage
evidence: account-series.md covers the identity promise/system, asset audit, six-role portfolio with deliberate commercial omission, two complementary series, seven-episode matrix, production limits, experiment, 7/30-day review, and rights fallback.

first-episode-directing-brief.json closes accountContext, audience/demand/job, contracts, narrative beats, claims/proof scope, carriers, shots, packaging, production, experiment, unknowns, and responsibility/rights.

gates.name: Evidence fidelity
evidence: The brief classifies the two supplied capabilities/assets as not-verified user_claims and the workflow/demand propositions as hypotheses; each consequential claim includes scope and cannotSupport.
account-series.md explicitly limits the artifact to process completeness and rejects inferences about virality, follower growth, copyright authorization, tool superiority, and causality.
The proof shot supports only component presence and navigation, explicitly not completeness, correctness, effectiveness, or causal results.
nonblocking: The published narration says third-party content is fully obscured; that remains a pre-publication human verification obligation, not an independently verified fact in the supplied evidence.

gates.name: Promise closure
evidence: Title, cover, and first frame all promise an AI video-analysis acceptance checklist of four objects while visibly disclaiming virality guarantees.

The body defines subtitles, visual evidence, timestamps, and edit decisions, demonstrates their navigability, assigns human/AI responsibility, and ends by checking the four cards and restating the proof boundary.
The follow contract names the next six deliverables and the single CTA asks for one stage-specific bottleneck, so continuation is tied to actual future value.

gates.name: Executability
evidence: The first episode supplies exact spoken lines, cognitive jobs, visuals, on-screen text, audio treatment, seven timed shots, evidence responsibilities, transitions, edit decisions, CTA, comment coding, and measurement rules.
Production assigns the account owner/solo creator, tools, locations, assets, Day-1 deadline, recording/edit limits, verification duties, and a synthetic-case fallback.
The series matrix gives every episode a distinct job, deliverable/proof object, limitation, and handoff; directory and catch-up behavior are specified.
nonblocking: Before batching Days 2–7, the account owner should turn each matrix row into the same capture/edit checklist used for Episode 1; the task only required a complete brief for Episode 1, so this is not a present delivery blocker.

gates.name: Production feasibility
evidence: The plan fits the supplied one-person, phone-plus-screen-recording, three-days-per-week capacity by using 45–60 second videos, batching, one task/object/CTA per episode, and explicit 90/150-minute recording/edit caps.
It avoids multi-person scenes and complex production, and replaces an unsafe real artifact with a creator-owned isomorphic mock labeled as a process demonstration.
Renewal and scope-reduction rules prevent the seven-day pilot from silently expanding into an unsustainable cadence.
nonblocking: Seven consecutive releases from three production days is plausible but still a capacity hypothesis; actual per-episode time must be logged and the stated three-overrun compression rule enforced.

gates.name: Original transfer
evidence: The task forbids copying the strongest-director title, mask, acerbic persona, and income endorsement; the plan instead selects the distinct 'AI work acceptance inspector' identity, four-card system, calm stance, and process-completeness proof.
The brief records no source inspiration and explicitly excludes titles of supremacy, masks, proprietary language, income/customer proof, third-party imagery, and identifiable source wording.
The proposed proof comes from the creator's own redacted structure or a creator-owned mock, not transferred case ownership or an unverifiable success claim.

gates.name: Measurement
evidence: Exactly one primary variable, opening, is declared; duration, four-card visual system, boundary statement, CTA, posting-time band, and lack of paid/manipulated distribution are locked.
The acquisition-aligned main metric, trust guardrail, 24-hour/7-day windows, minimum publication/comment evidence, confounds, directional decision rule, and stop/change rule are all explicit.
The plan calls the release non-random, preserves topic/proof/title/cover differences as confounds, and treats sub-threshold results as observation rather than causal proof.
nonblocking: The three 'comparable pairs' are not assigned in advance, and episodes necessarily vary in topic/proof object/title-cover; preregister pair membership and a comparability rule before publication.

Five substantive comments across the series is enough only for a weak directional observation. Report denominators and confidence limits, and do not use that threshold to claim viewer-level comprehension or demand validation.

gates.name: Safety and rights
evidence: All planned assets are creator-owned, system audio/music are excluded, and the referent ledger limits the screen recording to the creator's structure while excluding third-party images and identifiable text.
The human owner must verify timestamps, labels, privacy, and redaction before export; uncertain rights/privacy stop use of the real case and trigger a creator-owned mock fallback.
The script rejects virality, distribution, follower, revenue, ranking, and causal-result promises and avoids logos, income screenshots, likeness claims, health claims, and commercial conversion.
nonblocking: privacyChecks and platformChecks are structurally empty because no specific external person, sensitive datum, or current platform-rule claim is relied on; the account owner should still record the completed export-level redaction check before human approval.

nonblockingFindings.finding: Opening-variant pair membership and comparability are under-specified.
nonblockingFindings.requiredAction: Before posting, map the six variant episodes into three pairs and define acceptable topic/proof/duration differences; if no defensible pairing exists, describe the seven days as baseline observation rather than a paired comparison.

nonblockingFindings.finding: The five-comment floor is too small for more than directional qualitative learning.
nonblockingFindings.requiredAction: Preserve commenter and view denominators, report sparse cells, and prohibit demand or comprehension claims from this threshold alone.

nonblockingFindings.finding: The real artifact's final redaction is planned but not yet evidenced.
nonblockingFindings.requiredAction: The publishing owner must complete and record the export-level privacy/copyright check or use the stated creator-owned mock fallback.

judgeScores.evidence: The account promise is distinctive, accurately bounded to current assets, and expressed through complementary process and tool-choice series with explicit stop/renew rules.
Episode 1 progresses from visible object to tension, definition, navigable proof, responsibility, boundary, and continuation; every beat has a cognitive job and proof scope.
The seven shots have functional timing, transitions, readable card roles, and evidence duties within 55 seconds; actual phone readability still requires an export check.
Title/cover/first-frame align, search intent is named, comment coding and a directory/cross-link path are present, while the new account's actual field availability remains unknown.

A tool-overwhelmed solo creator can quickly identify the four acceptance objects, understand the limit of the proof, and see the next six useful deliverables; the audience premise remains a cold-start hypothesis.
The variable, metrics, window, floor, confounds, and change rule are explicit, but unmatched episode subjects and undefined pair assignment materially weaken attribution.
judgeScores.revision: Preregister three pair memberships and the comparability rule before release; if that cannot be done, downgrade the analysis to a seven-post observational baseline and carry opening as the sole next-round test.

finalDispositionNote: All G0-G7 semantic hard gates pass. JUDGE ran only after those passes. Nonblocking improvements do not authorize publication by themselves and do not convert sparse observational evidence into causal proof.

humanApproval.note: Human approval remains separate from reviewer readiness; approve only after final export readability and redaction/rights checks.
